name: kinetic
description: Mobile product design system for Flutter, SwiftUI, Compose and React Native: a multi-agent design studio (directors, rival, editor, blind critic panel), directions dealt from a native library, a decision record (KDL), component contracts, colour/type/layout floors, and a deterministic engine that validates, scans, measures clutter on renders, exports tokens and scores.

interface.shortDescription: Think like a design lead, ship like an engineer — mobile.
defaultPrompt: Use Kinetic to understand this mobile app, choose a distinctive direction, build the design system, implement it and prove the result.
